universe_note: Descriptive table, no test. It uses the registered Momentum, Value and Combined signals and portfolios, not the 12-1 sensitivity. Universe: names with available data only, affected by survivorship. The missing names are mostly acquired or bankrupt companies and are absent from the strategy and its benchmark alike, so survivorship affects both the levels and the differences; neither is an unbiased estimate. Yearly intervals on 8 to 12 months are wide and are not part of any test family.
